Purpose of this document
This report provides a human-readable audit of the agronomic knowledge extracted from the supplied textbooks and
agricultural reference materials. Each retained record contains the extracted agronomic statement, applicable crop or
parameter, explicit numerical information where available, source evidence and provenance. The report is intended to
support manual review before the knowledge base is used by the Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system. Important: Inclusion in this database means that the information was extracted and grounded in a supplied source. It
does not independently establish that every textbook recommendation is universally applicable. Agronomic
recommendations can depend on location, crop variety, soil type, growth stage and management conditions.
